pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Lift Off$(): Flies to a new site or lands where it hovers; trains nothing in the air$(br2)$(l)Orbital Command$(): Upgrades to an orbital command: energy, MULE, scans$(br2)$(l)Planetary Fortress$(): Upgrades to a planetary fortress: a cannon and armor$(br2)$(l)Calldown: MULE$(): A robot that mines 4 times faster for 64 s$(br2)$(l)Scanner Sweep$(): Reveals an area and cloaked units there for 12 s$(br2)$(l)Load$(): Takes aboard own ground units of its race nearby: a flyer 8 slots, a bunker 4 (6 with neosteel), a command center 5 SCVs, a nydus any zerg$(br2)$(l)Unload$(): Flies there and puts the cargo down; a building lets it out (a nydus the cargo of all its ends); a click on a rider in the panel lets it out alone
